subject: Post-call recap: Sentrum trial scope, infra preferences and next steps
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Paul Lin <paul.lin@sentrumhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Post-call recap: Sentrum trial scope, infra preferences and next steps

Paul — thanks for the call earlier. Quick written recap so we have a single source of truth and clear owners for the trial ramp: 

Summary of ask:
- 3-week POC to validate retrieval-augmented workflows for clinician notes summarization and triage routing.
- Success criteria: (1) end-to-end latency for summarization under 400ms p50, (2) summaries meet >85% accept rate in pilot prompts, (3) embeddings similarity recall >90% on test set.

Environment options you asked about:
1) Hosted API (fastest start) — Redwood-managed models, shared hosted pool, easiest to spin up. Recommended for initial functional evaluation.
2) Dedicated sandbox — reserved GPU pool in our infra for consistent throughput; good if you need sustained load and realistic perf profiling.
3) VPC trial (customer-managed network) — for data isolation and KMS ties; longer setup window (~2-3 weeks) but mirrors production for regulated data.

Your preference on the call was to start on Hosted API to unblock clinicians this week, then decide within the first 10 days whether to escalate to Dedicated sandbox for perf testing or to proceed with a VPC trial for compliance checks.

Action items / owners (proposed):
- Paul / Pilar (Sentrum): confirm dataset subset and provide sample anonymized notes (PII-redacted) by Thu 5/11 — OWNER: Sentrum (Paul/Pilar).
- Jasmine: provision Hosted trial workspace, create initial prompt set, share success criteria doc — ETA: 5/10.
- Ben: bench target models on Dedicated pool (if greenlit) and draft cost estimate for 3-week run — ETA for estimate: 5/12.
- Marissa: spin up security questionnaire (SOC2 items) and flag any VPC prerequisites — ETA: 5/15.

Attachments: Sentrum_Trial_Success_Criteria.xlsx (initial pass) attached.

If this looks right I’ll provision the Hosted workspace first thing tomorrow and share credentials.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.com]

[Attachment: Sentrum_Trial_Success_Criteria.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: Paul Lin <paul.lin@sentrumhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Pilar Kwan <pilark@sentrumhealth.com>, ProcureOps <procure@sentrumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 17:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Sentrum trial scope, infra preferences and next steps

Thanks Jasmine — this is exactly what we needed. Quick clarifications: 
- We can get a 1k note sample (PII redacted) to you by Friday 5/12.
- Our security/compliance lead wants to start the VPC conversation in parallel; procurement likely needs 2–3 weeks for PO paperwork.
- For decision velocity, let’s start with Hosted API for functional testing. If perf looks marginal under realistic sequences we’ll escalate to Dedicated sandbox.

Can you tee up an onboarding call for the engineering owner (cc’ed Pilar) next week? Also please include any IP/data handling notes we should circulate to our security team.

- Paul
Director of Engineering | Sentrum Health
paul.lin@sentrumhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Paul Lin <paul.lin@sentrumhealth.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Sentrum trial scope, infra preferences and next steps

Paul — quick note on the infra tradeoffs so Sentrum can plan ramp windows: 
- Hosted API: spin-up <24h, TTL tokens for user sessions, no network setup needed. Great for early prompt tuning and acceptance testing. Not suitable if you need full VPC network egress control or dedicated GPUs for higher sustained throughput.
- Dedicated sandbox: we can reserve a 2–4 GPU pool with guaranteed throughput; typical lead time 3–5 business days once PO/commit approved. I'll run a short cost model: baseline (3-week run, 2 GPUs) and a higher-throughput option (4 GPUs). ETA for numbers: 5/12 EOD.
- VPC trial: needs CIDR, firewall rules, and KMS fingerprints from your infra team. Typical setup schedule: 10–15 business days; we can run an initial smoke test in Hosted before switching traffic.

Recommended plan (practical):
1) Provision Hosted workspace now for prompt/functional test (Jasmine) — 48–72 hour window to get clinicians testing.
2) Parallel: Ben to return cost/throughput tradeoffs for Dedicated by 5/12.
3) Marissa/Karthik to start security questionnaire and list VPC prerequisites; Pilar to share infra contact.

I’ll include a sample benchmark script you can run against the Hosted endpoint so we capture realistic seq-length distributions.

-Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: bench_readme.md (text/plain)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Paul Lin <paul.lin@sentrumhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 13:46:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Sentrum trial scope, infra preferences and next steps

Paul — flagged a few compliance items to speed the VPC discussion: 
- VPC prerequisites we need: public IP ranges for egress filtering, accepted TLS cert fingerprints for inbound, and an on-call contact for networking during set-up.
- For the SOC2 checklist: we’ll need answers to service access controls, retention windows, and whether data will remain in-region. I attached the short questionnaire; please send to your security lead.

Timeline proposal: 
- 5/10–5/12: Hosted provisioning and initial functional testing (Jasmine).
- 5/12–5/15: Ben delivers Dedicated cost/throughput options.
- 5/15–5/26: If Customer opts in, start VPC provisioning (network handoff + KMS) — estimated 8–12 business days.

Small ask: please confirm who will sign the PO (ProcureOps contact is cc’d) and whether a non-disclosure amendment is required for the trial dataset.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sentrum_soc2_questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Paul Lin <paul.lin@sentrumhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Pilar Kwan <pilark@sentrumhealth.com>, ProcureOps <procure@sentrumhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 May 2028 11:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Sentrum trial scope, infra preferences and next steps

All — thanks for the cadence. Confirmations: 
- We’ll send the 1k redacted note sample by 5/12 EOD (Pilar).
- Procurement: ProcureOps is the signatory; expect PO draft by 5/23.
- Security: I’ve looped our infra/security contact (same thread) to start the SOC2 questionnaire. We prefer Hosted first; if benchmarks show p50 latency >400ms we will request Dedicated sandbox.

Next step: Jasmine, please share Hosted workspace credentials and the bench script so Pilar’s team can run the first pass on Monday.

-Paul
